profile.name: Dongwoo NAM
profile.summary: An otologic surgeon and physician-scientist with an MD from Seoul National University, a PhD in Medicine (Otolaryngology) from Chungbuk National University, and graduate training in statistics and data science. My work spans otology, neurotology, vestibular medicine, clinical outcomes research, Bayesian clinical decision support, and computable clinical knowledge.

entries.title: ClinKBE: Reproducible Bayesian Computable Knowledge for BPPV and Ménière Disease
entries.subtitle: Current public research framework · v0.3.0
entries.org: Open-source computable clinical-knowledge framework
bullets: ClinKBE is currently a vestibular-domain executable Bayesian knowledge framework covering active BPPV and Ménière disease/hydrops families.
Authored, reviewable clinical knowledge is transformed into versioned executable Knowledge Objects and processed by a shared Bayesian inference engine.
The framework separates evidence models from priors and supports exact CPD-based inference, explicit prior specification, Bayes-factor reporting, and prior-sensitivity analysis.
Status: evaluated with synthetic inputs as research software; patient-level calibration and external validation remain future work. It is not a validated standalone clinical diagnostic tool.

entries.title: Questionnaire-Based Logistic-CPD Clinical Decision Support System for Dizziness
entries.subtitle: Clinician-facing implementation
entries.org: Sole developer, software architect, and clinical implementer
bullets: Internal questionnaire-based clinical decision-support system used in outpatient dizziness practice at SMG-SNU Boramae Medical Center.
Collects structured symptom data and inferences to generate differential diagnostic rankings, independent posterior probabilities, and recommendations for next diagnostic tests.
Designed as a clinician-in-the-loop aid; final diagnosis, testing, and management remain under physician judgment.
This clinical implementation is distinct from the publicly archived ClinKBE and Vestibular-GenBN research software.

entries.title: Vestibular-GenBN
entries.subtitle: Predecessor to ClinKBE
entries.org: A modular generative Bayesian network framework for vestibular diagnostic knowledge engineering
bullets: Earlier open-source framework for modular representation of vestibular diagnostic knowledge and reproducible Bayesian inference research.

ClinKBE is a substantive redesign of this work, adding family-scoped mutually exclusive root states, an explicit source-to-runtime build contract, exact CPD-based inference, and separate prior/Bayes-factor reporting.
Preserved as part of the public development lineage rather than presented as a separate deployed clinical system.
